title: The ultimate guide to adding a PLG motion | Hila Qu (Reforge, GitLab)
summary: Brought to you by Amplitude —Build better products | Miro —A collaborative visual platform where your best work comes to life | Ahrefs —Improve your website’s SEO for free — Hila Qu is an Executive in Residence at Reforge as well as a renowned growth advisor, angel investor, and published author (her book about growth was named one of the top 10 business books of 2018 in China). Previously, she served as the Director of Growth at GitLab, where she implemented and scaled their PLG motion, and VP of Growth at Acorns, scaling them from 1 million to 5 million users. In today’s episode, we discuss: • The importance of having both a product-led and a sales-led motion for companies of all sizes • A step-by-step process for implementing PLG • Common pitfalls of layering on PLG • How to audit your existing funnel • Conversion, activation, and retention tactics • Structuring your growth organization from day one, and as it scales — Find the full transcript at:
